title: Function Inhibition Caller
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Function Inhibition Manager (FiM)/Function_Inhibition_Caller.md
text: Call AUTOSAR Function Inhibition Manager (FiM) service interface FunctionInhibition; {Client port name} sets the name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call FiM service interface, {Operation} sets the operation defined in FiM service interface FunctionInhibition and {Sample time} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Client port name
params.values: Name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call FiM service interface FunctionInhibition FunctionInhibition (default) | character vector

params.name: Operation
params.values: Specify operation defined in FiM service interface FunctionInhibition GetFunctionPermission (default)
